environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime) behind API Gateway REST API (v1). CloudFront distribution fronts the API Gateway origin with a custom origin request policy. The distribution has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:global/webacl/ci-pipeline-protection/abc123) containing: (1) a custom rule group 'json-body-validation' with a RegexPatternSet match on $.body.build_args field using pattern `^[a-zA-Z0-9_=\-\s\.]{0,256}$` in BLOCK mode with priority 1, and (2) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestriction_BODY rule overridden to COUNT. Additionally, the Lambda environment has SRI hashes populated: SRI_DEPLOY_SHA384=a8b9c0d1e2f3...pinned, SRI_TEST_SHA384=b1c2d3e4f5a6...pinned, SRI_LINT_SHA384=c2d3e4f5a6b7...pinned (actual SHA-384 of vetted scripts). API Gateway has a request validator requiring the body to conform to a JSON schema model that restricts build_args to maxLength 256 with pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_=\-\s\.]*$. The Lambda execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/deny-network-and-exec) that includes an explicit Deny on lambda:InvokeFunction for any principal outside the account, though this is primarily for lateral movement prevention.
